tools.name: get_payment_info
tools.description: Discover multilingual social media campaign copy optimization: persona-based evaluation, costs, networks and payment options. No AI or payment is performed.

tools.name: prepare_purchase
tools.description: Estimate multilingual SNS/social media campaign copy improvement using synthetic audience personas, preserving campaign facts and hashtags. Set request.output_language to a language tag or auto. Returns an upto authorization ceiling and payment URL; no AI or payment is performed.

tools.name: get_purchase_status
tools.description: Read only this purchase's progress, usage and payment receipt.

tools.name: get_purchase_result
tools.description: Retrieve the JSON only after completed processing and confirmed payment.

tools.name: prepare_credit_topup
tools.description: Prepare exact EIP-3009 USDC credit funding without registration. Does not transfer funds. Save and back up the returned access_token; unused credits stay available.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Read USDC credit balance, reserved budget and spendable balance.

tools.name: get_credit_topup_status
tools.description: Read exact top-up status and confirmed settlement receipt. Does not retry a transfer.

tools.name: prepare_credit_purchase
tools.description: Estimate multilingual social media campaign participation copy optimization and synthetic persona-response evaluation using USDC credits. Set request.output_language to a language tag or auto. Usage-based pricing; no AI or payment is performed by this estimate. Model recommended and max_model_cost_u

tools.name: create_credit_order
tools.description: Reserve USDC credits and start a purchase. The final usage charge within the quoted ceiling is debited on success; failed work releases the hold. Poll get_purchase_status then get_purchase_result.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_purchase" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
